_provenance.source: OutLayer contract source checkout, repo https://github.com/out-layer/outlayer.git @ a2a8510528d9c8051e63765783d1e4ed998a273a, contract/src/execution.rs `pub fn request_execution` + contract/src/lib.rs types (ExecutionSource, ResourceLimits, SecretsReference, ResponseFormat, RequestParams); corroborated by the live outlayer.testnet panic recorded in services/e2e/live-run16/results.json (tx 6U8HN1hWiESqhfVgZFna3MMCHcVMYB438EoLu9jCnKEJ: 'missing field `source`') and the vault note 'OutLayer production setup' (raw `near contract call-function ... request_execution file-args`).

args_wire_format: ONE top-level JSON object whose keys are the parameter names below (near-sdk multi-arg method). NOT wrapped in {"args_json": "..."}.

payer_account_id.note: refund recipient; defaults to predecessor (= the escrow when it calls)

return_shape.summary: request_execution itself returns nothing; it creates a yield promise. The caller's .then() callback receives the on_execution_response return value: the guest's output as a JSON value (Json format: the guest's JSON object; Text: JSON string; Bytes: base64 string), or `null` when the run failed / produced nothing.
return_shape.no_unused_compute_field: OutLayer does NOT report unused compute to the caller. Excess deposit (payment - cost) is transferred natively to payer_account_id (default: predecessor) by OutLayer's callback.
return_shape.promise_failed: Malformed args or insufficient payment => the call panics => caller sees PromiseResult::Failed.
